label: tgi
notes: target may use every CPU: llmperfscope shares CPUs with it

load.why: 1.4 CPU cores busy and the GPU 2% busy: host work, spread over threads that take turns.

warmup.why: 0.31 s is too short for the GPU's utilization counter. Use a longer run.

serve_c1.why: GPU 81% busy with nothing else saturated, so the rest of the time is host work or synchronization. --nsys shows the gaps, --cpu-profile what the host does.

serve_c4.why: GPU 81% busy with nothing else saturated, so the rest of the time is host work or synchronization. --nsys shows the gaps, --cpu-profile what the host does.

memory.text: The process holds 6.52 GiB of its own host RAM during serve, next to 6.81 GiB on the GPU. If that is a copy of the weights it can usually be released after upload.

serving.text: Going from 1 to 4 concurrent requests raised throughput 3.44 times, and the median first token moved from 38 to 91 ms.

next_steps: --nsys: which kernels take the GPU's time, and what it waits on in the gaps
--cpu-profile: which functions the host threads spend their time in
